scheme_name: Scheme for Margin Money Grant to Nano Units
other_conditions: The applicant must be a new Nano proprietary enterprise with a project cost (fixed capital + working capital) up to ₹10 lakhs.
The unit must not have previously received any grant assistance from the Government of India, Government of Kerala or Local Self‑Government departments.
The unit must be operational at the time the assistance is released and must continue operating continuously for three years from that date.
Applicants must provide true information, allow verification/inspection of the plant, machinery and other assets, and produce original documents if required.
The applicant must execute the required legal agreement (online or on paper) and use the received amount only as stipulated.

Preference is given to women, persons with disabilities, ex‑servicemen, and individuals belonging to SC/ST, as well as youth entrepreneurs up to 40 years, but these are not mandatory eligibility criteria.
benefits_summary: Provides a margin money grant of 30‑40% of the total project cost, with an additional 10% for women, youth (18‑40), disabled persons, ex‑servicemen or SC/ST categories, up to a maximum of ₹4 lakhs per unit.
documents_required: Title deed of land or land tax receipt or lease agreement or rent agreement (as applicable)
Ownership Certificate of the building (if any)
Invoice or bill of plant and machinery
